messages:
morgan: Hey folks — I pushed a followup that addresses the review comments (split the KV cache allocator fix into a separate commit and added the unit test you asked for). PTAL when you have a minute. link: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/runtime/merge_requests/412

jordan: Thanks — will look in ~30. Quick q: did you change any public APIs or just internal helpers?

morgan: Only internal helpers. No API surface changes, but one helper signature did get a param renamed (internal-only). I've noted it in the PR description.

sam: CI bot is complaining about a flaky test in integration-suite, looks unrelated to your change. Also left one tiny nit about a variable name, nothing blocking.

ci-bot: GitLab CI: pipeline #412.5 — jobs: build ✅, unit-tests ✅, integration-suite ❌ (flake: test_integration_cache_rotate)

alex: @morgan I skimmed the diff — LGTM apart from sam's nit. Do you want me to approve and we squash before merging, or keep the split commits?

morgan: I'd prefer to keep split commits for blame clarity unless folks want squashed history. If we need a clean changelog entry we can squash during merge.

natalie: +1 to keeping split commits. Approving after sam's nit is addressed.

sam: tiny nit fixed in latest push. No behavior changes.

jordan: Re-reviewed, looks good. Approving now.

ci-bot: GitLab CI: pipeline #412.7 — all jobs ✅

morgan: Awesome, thanks all. I'll wait 15m for any last objections, then merge. If ci passes again I'll merge and schedule a quick canary roll (low traffic).

alex: Sounds good. One more ask — can you add a short note to the changelog snippet? just a one-liner: "fix: stabilize KV allocator rotation to avoid double-free on eviction"

morgan: Added changelog line in the PR description. Merging when CI stays green. :shipit:
